# UDEV Gothic

Unmodified Regular and Bold fonts from the official UDEV Gothic 2.2.0 release.
`manifest.json` records their origin and SHA-256 digests.

License and copyright: [UDEV-Gothic.txt](../../licenses/UDEV-Gothic.txt).
`pnpm run generate` losslessly compresses these fonts to WOFF2 using wawoff2.
Generated files live in `src/generated/fonts/` and are not committed.
No subsetting, glyph changes, or naming changes are applied.

Yu Gothic UI is referenced as an installed system font only; it is not distributed.
